theta_grid.declared: 2026-11-24, on main e14f5bf3 (contains COVID-EMIT-FINE-01), before any cell on the post-adoption scale
theta_grid.lattice: thetas is the runnable half-decade lattice 1e5..1e10, not the scored grid. Its span is a bound, not a conversion: theta scales dose on every route and the adoption raised only the zone airborne pool (x1.7e4), so the new-scale theta lies between old/1.7e4 (airborne pool the only route) and old (airborne pool negligible); FIT-01's old-unit bracket (1e9, 1e10) maps to no point inside it.

pilot.how: the first 5 seeds of each decade's canary block (scripts/campaign submit --size 5); the same cells the full block would run
pilot.statistic: median over the 5 seeds of positives through day 31 (P31, all seeds, unconditioned), against 634
pilot.reads: only the T3 side of each decade and the dead/saturated edges. No contract leg is scored from pilot cells; they are 5-seed provisional rows.

theta_grid.selection_rule: theta_hi = the lowest pilot decade whose median P31 >= 634; theta_lo = the decade below it. Scored grid = {theta_lo, 3.16*theta_lo, theta_hi, 3.16*theta_hi}, dropping a value above the lattice. Canary = 20 seeds at 3.16*theta_lo. If no pilot decade reaches 634, or the lowest one already does, no grid is declared and that is reported. A pilot median that falls back below 634 above theta_hi is reported and does not move the grid.
